reason: Adopt SillyTavern 1.18.0 Persona/Character/Prompt source capabilities as the mandatory OSS basis for Yance Persona Card, Character Card import/validation, Character Description, Personality, Scenario, Character Note/depth injection, Example Dialogues, prompt ordering/placement and the suitable CharacterBook/World Info data and matching primitives. The implementation must replace/thin the existing Yance-owned flat Persona prompt composition rather than create a second Persona framework. Letta remains long-term agent/interaction memory authority, Graphiti remains temporal relationship-fact authority, Parlant remains Goal/Journey authority, and the existing Yance AI gateway and send authority remain unchanged. SillyTavern UI, provider/model gateways, server endpoints, global chat state and swipe UI are explicitly excluded.

productCompositionContract.nativeRegisterTarget: Natural short-form WhatsApp chat that reflects the user's explicit persona and learned style without nationality/age stereotyping.

ossFit.reasonForFullFileExclusions: The excluded full files are inseparably coupled to SillyTavern DOM/UI, global chat state, tokenizers, provider/model routing, server endpoints or product lifecycle. P0 adopts the independently portable modules and exact source slices instead of importing a second SillyTavern product shell.

mandatoryFailureFirstContracts: Implementation must start only from the ordinary two-parent merge commit of this authorization proposal and only on product/v21-persona-character-p0-v1.

The exact SillyTavern upstream must remain release 1.18.0 at commit 51ad27fb86d39a3daca3adaa970375c9670c12df; every adopted source path must match the recorded upstream Git blob before any compatibility transformation.
Character Card PNG V2/V3 parsing, ccv3-over-chara precedence, write/read round trip and TavernCardValidator behavior must fail before the vendored upstream modules are wired and pass afterward.
The three direct PNG parser dependencies must be exactly crc@4.3.2, png-chunk-text@1.0.0 and png-chunks-extract@1.0.0 with package-lock integrity; mutable direct ranges are RED.

Prompt composition must use the SillyTavern-derived Prompt/PromptCollection ordering and explicit relative/absolute injection position, depth and order semantics; replacing them with a new Yance ordering engine is RED.

Character Description, Personality, Scenario, Persona Description, Character Note/depth injection and Example Dialogues must remain distinct composition units and must not be flattened into one concatenated Persona prompt string.
Example Dialogues must be a first-class ordered input and preserve user/assistant conversational examples rather than being reduced to descriptive prose.

SillyTavern-derived CharacterBook/World Info handling may organize persona/scenario/example composition material and use the adopted matching primitives, but it must not persist, infer or supersede real contact facts.
World Info recursive global chat-state, token-budget and UI engine must not be partially reimplemented in Yance P0; importing that full runtime or creating an equivalent Yance engine is RED.
The existing labels 暧昧, 小女人, 风骚, 调情, 个性, 温柔, 成熟, 高冷, 主动, 神秘, 幽默 and 俏皮 must remain available as structured Style Overlay resolver inputs; direct flat prompt concatenation of the label weights is RED.
Persona, Locale Profile, Chat Register, Relationship Card and Style Overlay must remain distinct inputs; nationality or age must not select a stereotyped persona template.

de-DE and de-AT fixtures must prove the composition contract prefers native WhatsApp register and explicitly rejects translationese, email/customer-service tone, over-explaining, overly complete AI sentences, repeated questions, emoji overuse, neediness/overeagerness, relationship-stage mismatch and assistant clichés.

All three Persona/Character failure-first suites must live under tests/wp0/ so tools/wp0/run-tests.js discovers them automatically; relying on a manually invoked side test command or an un-gated test directory is RED.
Relationship stage may alter allowed tone/placement through the read-only Relationship Card projection, but Persona code must not become a second relationship fact store.

Letta long-term agent/interaction memory, Graphiti temporal relationship facts and Parlant Goal/Journey authority must remain unchanged; this work package must not modify their runtime, storage, routes, workflows or authorization files.

The existing Yance AI gateway remains the only model execution boundary; no SillyTavern provider code, second model gateway, LiteLLM/RouteLLM implementation or provider credential path may be introduced.
No SillyTavern UI, settings shell, chat state, swipe picker or second candidate UI may be introduced; existing Yance candidate generation and unique send authority remain intact.

AGPL-3.0 obligations must be explicit before GREEN: package license declaration, vendored license text, preserved upstream notices/provenance, Corresponding Source availability for covered distribution, and Section 13 source offer when the modified covered program is used through a computer network.

The mechanically adapted CommonJS vendored modules and source-slice file must contain exact upstream repository/commit/path/blob provenance and a minimal transformation record; clean-room rewritten equivalents are RED.
The implementation must remain compatible with Yance Node >=22.19.0 and Electron 39.8.5 on Windows without adding native build/runtime requirements for Persona/Character parsing.
The final implementation changed-path set must remain within these 20 exact paths and retain SHA-256 ddde51c01a6d56ecdec4a4d12cee1a75af17a258ec95bdb164a31c3d7586b47e.
Independent exact-Head review must have zero unresolved P0/P1 findings before implementation merge.
